name: New Lead Nurture
description: When a new lead record is created in Airtable, triggers SCAA-1 Battle Plan assignment, Slack alert to #sales-team, and CEO welcome email via Gmail.

config.description: Assign SCAA-1 Battle Plan based on segment and zone
config.code: const segment = inputData.segment; const zone = inputData.zone; const propertyValue = parseFloat(inputData.property_value) || 0; let priority = 'Standard'; if (segment === 'Investor' && propertyValue >= 5000000) priority = 'Investor Track'; else if (segment === 'Luxury' || segment === 'Absentee') priority = 'Priority 1'; else if (segment === 'Seasonal') priority = 'Priority 2'; else if (segment === 'STR') priority = 'Priority 3'; output = { priority, segment, zone, property_value: propertyValue, battle_plan: 'SCAA-1', sequence_start: new Date().toISOString() };

config.message: NEW LEAD | {{trigger.name}} | {{step1.segment}} | {{step1.zone}} | ${{step1.property_value}} | Priority: {{step1.priority}} | Battle Plan: SCAA-1 assigned

config.subject: New Lead: {{trigger.name}} | {{step1.zone}} | {{step1.priority}}
